name: phase2b_dispersion_gated_funding
rationale: Phase 2 证明 funding 截面排序带信息（B 空头腿 +5.3%→+26.2%、MDD 29.6%→20.0%），且失效与截面离散度同步收缩（21.8%→7.3%）。新假设：截面策略只在分化足够大时有正期望，低分化期应强制 FLAT 而不是付过路费。独立契约，重新计数。
universe_note: 完全复用 Phase 2 宽池，零新拉数据。

signal.score: mean(funding rate over last 42 settlements up to D-1 close) * 1095 * 100, annualized %
signal.direction: short top 3 highest funding, long bottom 3 lowest funding
signal.insufficient_history: coin excluded from ranking that week (not filled with 0)

dispersion_gate.metric: stdev of 14-day returns across the day's pool members, * 100, unit %
dispersion_gate.percentile_method: linear interpolation on sorted IS values: idx = 0.30 * (n - 1)
dispersion_gate.apply_to: all rebalance dates as one fixed constant (IS uses the percentile, OOS uses the same frozen number)
dispersion_gate.on_trigger: all weights = 0. No funding accrual. Closing turnover is still charged.

positions.weighting: equal weight, gross exposure = 1.0 when invested, net = 0

funding.accrual: actual settled rate every 8h, applied to held weight
funding.sign: long pays positive rate, short receives

oos_insufficient_rule: If OOS traded (non-FLAT) rebalances < 12, Q1-Q3 cannot be evaluated; verdict becomes INCONCLUSIVE rather than FALSIFIED. Full-sample gates are still reported.

random_control.scheme: same day, same pool, same FLAT schedule, random 3 long / 3 short, identical costs and funding
random_control.note: FLAT schedule must match the real strategy, otherwise the control pays costs in weeks where the strategy is flat and the comparison is confounded

diagnostics: ungated pure funding (threshold disabled): read-only comparison, NOT part of the verdict
FLAT ratio in IS and OOS, reported separately
forbidden: 跑完后修改阈值、分位点或切分点
把 ungated 诊断列当作判定依据
用未来数据补齐缺失币种
